name: a01_sac_hybrid4_q4_async_r1
description: J4 speed-up proposal (J4-04..06, 2026-09-30): hybrid4_v1 SAC with the q4 critic (twin critics [s, steer] -> 4 Q-values, one pass for the four-command expectation), asynchronous learner thread (collection and gradient steps in parallel), 1 gradient step per transition. Same losses as hybrid4_v1; not validated by any learning result. Not a controlled D25 arm against the historical hybrid runs (critic, schedule and async differ).

budget.note: Bounded proposal, user-started run (D37). Same transition budget as the J4 runs; wall time is expected to be shorter, not the learning.

reward_status: trackmania_rl.reward/1 coefficients are a J3 PROPOSITION (J3-02), not approved
